## What this PR does

<!-- One or two lines. e.g. "Adds three ABM framework resources to Agent-Based Modelling." -->

## Type of change

- [ ] New resource(s)
- [ ] Broken-link fix
- [ ] New or changed section (discussed in an issue first)
- [ ] Documentation / wording
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Entry format

Each new entry follows:

`- [Author(s) — Title (Year)](url) ` + "`type`" + ` — one sentence on what it contributes to the simulation engine.`

Type labels: `paper` `book` `article` `tool` `framework` `course` `dataset` `chapter`

## Checklist

- [ ] Entries are placed under an existing `### Section` (or the section change was agreed in an issue).
- [ ] Each one-liner states the **contribution to a simulation engine** in one neutral sentence (≤250 characters, no rankings or superlatives).
- [ ] Links are stable (DOI, publisher, or official project page preferred).
- [ ] No duplicate of an existing entry (checked cross-referenced sections).
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_readme.py` reports no errors (CI runs it too).
- [ ] PR title is short and descriptive (e.g. `Add three ABM framework resources`).

## Notes for the reviewer

<!-- For broken-link fixes, note the replacement source. Anything else worth knowing goes here. -->
